{{Short description|None}} {{Use mdy dates|date=January 2025}} This is a list of [[National Football League]] [[running back]]s by total career [[rushing yards]], and includes the 32 running backs who have rushed for at least 10,000 yards, for which sixteen of them have been inducted into the [[Pro Football Hall of Fame]]. [[Emmitt Smith]] leads with 18,355 yards and is also the postseason leader with 1,586. He has held the all-time rushing yards record since 2002 and is the only player with over 17,000 regular season rushing yards. ==Players with at least 10,000 rushing yards== [[File:EmmittSmith2007 (crop).jpg|thumb|[[Emmitt Smith]] has the most rushing yards with 18,355.]] {| class="wikitable" |+ Key | style="text-align:center; background:#ffb;"|^ | Inducted into the [[Pro Football Hall of Fame]] |- | style="text-align:center; background:#cfecec;"|* | Denotes player who is still active |} ''Through Week 10 of the {{NFL year|2026}} season.'' {{sticky header}} {| class="wikitable sortable sticky-header" style="text-align:center;" |- !Rank !Player !Team(s) by season !{{tooltip|Carries|Career rushing attempts}} !{{tooltip|Yards|Career rushing yards}} !{{tooltip|Average|Career average yards per carry, rounded to the nearest tenth}} |- |1 |style="background:#ffb;"|[[Emmitt Smith]]^ |[[Dallas Cowboys]] ([[1990 NFL season|1990]]–[[2002 NFL season|2002]])

[[Baltimore Ravens]] ([[2024 NFL season|2024]]–present) |198 |1,002 |5.1 |} ==Historical rushing yards leaders== Seven players have been recognized as having held the career rushing yards record in the NFL. Since reliable yardage statistics were not recorded prior to 1932, the first NFL player recognized as the career leader in rushing yards was [[Cliff Battles]], who played from 1932 to 1937 for the [[Washington Redskins|Boston Braves / Boston Redskins / Washington Redskins]].{{Cite web |last=Frye |first=Brian |date=June 28, 2016 |title=History of the Career Rushing Yards Record |url=http://www.thegridfe.com/2016/06/28/history-career-rushing-yards-record/ |access-date=September 25, 2016 |website=thegridfe.com |publisher=GridFe |archive-date=September 27, 2016 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160927114425/http://www.thegridfe.com/2016/06/28/history-career-rushing-yards-record/ |url-status=live }} He led the NFL with 576 yards in 1932 and held on to the record throughout his career.
